findings.summary: Calculated results need conditions stated beside them: $57.53 is one 30-day cycle of simple interest on a flat $5,000, 365-day basis, assuming the card stays available at 10% with no new fees; the drop table uses a hypothetical $100,000 balance and symmetric arithmetic ignoring ongoing contributions and time to recover.
findings.fix: Writer must label the hypothetical inputs, attribute as 'In our internal modeling' (calculated, not tested), cite CRS for tradeoffs (access, fees), and add the counterexample: at an issuer response of fees or lost access the saving disappears; recovery time depends on returns, and contributions during a drop buy at lower prices.

findings.summary: 401(k) takeaway must not become personal sell/hold advice or attribute 'selling locks in losses' or rebalancing rules to FINRA (the page does not say that).
findings.fix: Takeaway: conditional on time horizon and goals, FINRA's process points (goals, diversification, avoid impulsive moves, dollar-cost averaging, verify registration), and a prompt to consult a registered professional; disclaimers at the bottom only; link to portfolio rebalancing calculator without attributing rebalancing guidance to FINRA.
